reviews.text:
I would like to thank the whole team for the care and kindness they showed Mimi during all the days I was there with her.
The whole team was exceptional — receptionists, nurses, vets and the surgeon. Everyone was truly 5-star.
I would especially like to thank Dr Pedro, the surgeon, for all the attention, care and compassion he gave to my little Mimi throughout the days she needed treatment.
I am very grateful to everyone for their professionalism, support and kindness.🤍
Ana

I called today to get help with my kitten due to a minor emergency we had and they assisted my wife and I over the phone to make sure our kitten was fine.

We didn't end up needing to take her to the practice, but I can imagine the excellent service we would have received if we had gone there. This is not my local Medivet, but I'm absolutely glad to have them within reach.

I wanted to update my review now that some time has passed. When I originally wrote it, I was extremely emotional after losing my cat Minnie, who meant the absolute world to me.
Looking back more clearly, I want to recognise the kindness and compassion shown to Minnie during his treatment. The veterinary team did everything they could for him and treated both Minnie and me with genuine care during an incredibly difficult time.
Losing him was devastating, and understandably my emotions were very raw at the time. I don't want those emotions to overshadow the care and kindness Minnie received.
I'm incredibly grateful to everyone who looked after my little boy and treated him with dignity and compassion. Thank you for taking care of Minnie when he needed you most. I'll always appreciate that.

I had a lovely experience at Medivet, especially thanks to Dr Paula, who was absolutely wonderful!

She was incredibly kind, caring, patient and professional with both me and my dogs. She was particularly gentle and understanding with Sunny, who was extremely stressed and nervous during our visit. Dr Paula made us feel comfortable and reassured throughout the appointment. Her communication was excellent, and she took the time to explain everything clearly, giving us the attention and support we needed. She is not only a fantastic vet but also a genuinely warm and compassionate person. I couldn’t be more grateful for her care!

The only downside to our visit was the parking situation, which was unfortunately quite stressful. The car park was extremely busy, with no suitable spaces available. I ended up having to park in an area used by pedestrians and had to interrupt the consultation to go outside and move my car. This made an already stressful visit with nervous dogs even more difficult.

I genuinely love this clinic and appreciate the wonderful care the team provides. My feedback about the parking is simply a suggestion for improvement, as a better parking arrangement would make a huge difference to the overall experience for clients and their pets.

A big thank you to Dr Paula for her exceptional care, kindness and professionalism. She truly deserves recognition! ❤️🐾

I can't explain how grateful I am to this team for being so informative and considerate over the phone, when nowhere else was open. My senior cat swallowed something he shouldn't have, and they explained the risks, my options, and were very transparent about pricing over the phone. When I went in at 2 in the morning panicked, I was met with kindness, and they quickly treated my cat with so much love and concern. Truly professional and compassionate people here who love your fur babies like their own. Thank you so much.
Great service and advice for my rescue dog

I am deeply disappointed by my recent experiences at Medivet Hendon. My cat is currently suffering from a severe mouth problem, is in visible pain, and can barely eat wet food. Despite this, the clinic seems entirely focused on rigid administrative procedures and making money rather than helping an animal in distress.I sent an email to notify the clinic that I was coming to collect my cat's medication. The nurse on duty actively admitted that she saw my email, but chose not to reply or call me to let me know the prescription wasn't ready. Instead, she let me travel all the way to the clinic just to turn me away. Her attitude was highly defensive and argumentative. She hid behind protocol, stating that it takes 48 hours for a "big clinic" to process medication. She then told me that if I wanted the medicine tonight, I would have to pay a premium for an emergency out-of-hours consultation with the night vet—otherwise, I would have to wait until tomorrow for the day vet. It feels entirely like a "no money, no talk" policy where patient well-being comes last.
To make matters worse, two days prior, the same nurse was incredibly rude about a failed direct debit for our health plan. She uncompassionately demanded payment for an outstanding balance while coldly telling me I had completely missed the health check. I settled the bill immediately upon finding out, but the lack of basic empathy throughout both interactions has been shocking.
I will be looking for a vet clinic that actually cares about animals over profit margins.

We saw the emergency vet for our kitten. He was professional and kind and went above and beyond. We felt very well looked after by all of the staff in what was a stressful time. Our kitten is now well and I can't thank the team at Hendon enough 😊 …
Medivet is okay , only annoying is that harassment by email to get a review

Always good experience & friendly.
My cat Simba used to be hard to handle but is now so relaxed at his examinations which shows he views this as a safe & comfortable space to be handled.

This was our first visit to Medivet Hendon. Our cat hadn’t eaten properly for two days, and we became increasingly worried over the weekend. The team managed to give us an appointment within just a few hours, which we really appreciated.

Our cat was seen by Dr Denis, who was excellent. He examined her thoroughly, explained everything clearly and talked us through the available options with complete transparency. We felt reassured and very well looked after. We’re extremely happy with the care we received and would highly recommend the practice.

Was at HGS not Hendon.
With Dr Vicky. Thursday September 3rd.
Mitzi the Chihuahua annual check up and vaccinations.
Both got on well, no problems at all.
Used to go to HGS and went to Hendon to  follow/see Jeremy Carr gone to Stanmore now.

Too many different vets at Hendon seen Dr Vicky now nearer home. Parking can be difficult at Hendon.
Very rude and unprofessional on the phone .
Such an amazing team that really cares for our dog

I just would like to say a big Thank you, for everyone, who's working there...you guys was always brilliant, and helped me in my hardest time...you have been always looked after my babies.  Thank you very much, for all your hard work, and support towards me,when i needed it..thank you again 😍 …

These people are angels. Twice now I’ve taken stray cats and kittens who were in need of veterinary care and both times medivet provided that care and took the cats in. It’s appalling that someone here gave them a bad review because they weren’t all smiles when accepting stray kittens from them. What on earth do you expect from people doing a difficult job?! Cat charities and animal hospitals are completely overwhelmed and most aren’t able to take in stray cats. I’m grateful for their care and kindness towards the stray cats and kittens I took to them
Great service
Extremely professional, efficient and caring staff who provided us with clear information every step of the way with diagnosis and treatment of our very ill dog.
As usual staff were very professional helpful pleasant and friendly. My dog Bobbie and I are always treated with respect and kindness.

Terrible! DO NOT GO TO THIS VET. We took our dog on Friday night for an emergency appt. Was given a diagnosis of heatstroke based solely on our dog’s temperature…. no other examination performed. An injection was administered in our dog’s lower back and sent home to monitor. Today (3 days later) our dog has undergone major emergency surgery for a heart condition at the Royal Veterinary College.

Staff are wonderful, very kind and helpful. Our dog unfortunately has been poorly and we came in for an emergency appointment on Sunday and the wonderful vet Nicola assisted us with Luna ❤️ Would most definitely recommend this practice to everyone as their pets to be in good hands ☺️
Easy to book appointment,  appointment on time no problems. Happy
It’s extremely sad to see my old cat sick, yet the members at HENDON remain thoughtful and professional and my cat made it home after 4 days and 3 night care, thank you
Very good and professional vet practice!

Daniele Cortelli is doing a fantastic job looking after our dog, Benji, who was recently diagnosed with an autoimmune disease.

He has kept in close contact with us throughout the journey and has kept us informed at every stage about the type and dosage of medication Benji needs.

We can really rely on Daniele, and we know that our dog is in very good hands. He is a caring, responsible, and dedicated vet, and we are extremely grateful for the excellent care he has given Benji.

I took two of my cats to Medivet Hendon for emergency appointments and they were great (although very busy). On both occasions they saved me a lot of stress as other vets (including my own assigned emergency vet) were not accepting patients. They were also thorough in their physical examination and did a ultrasound on my cat (without anesthesia) to verify that he didn’t have a blockage or something else going on but didn’t charge extra for it. It’s honestly a relief to have this vet close by.
Very attentive to clients and pets. Ready to help with any issues and find a right way.

I took my cat to the medivet at Hendon, and they have been most supportive and nice. The gentleman at the reception put a calming blanket on my cat’s box to calm her down. Then the Dr.  Called us in. He examined my cat very carefully and checked everything on her body. I am most grateful to them for all their kind, gentle and thorough examination as part of my monthly plan. Thank you very much to all those who work there.
Brought Snowy in for her yearly check-up. Great service, very gentle with her, and everything explained properly. Friendly staff and a clean practice. Would definitely recommend.

Amazing service for my two poms. 1 of my poms had a grass seed in her ear, the vet got it removed and her out of pain within a hour. The vet I saw recently, set up all reminders for my poms vaccinations and treatments and treated them both with love and care.

Thank you :)
Very nice girls in reception, saw vet on time,problem dealt with.great experience

I had an emergency with my cat and was advised to phone Medivet Hendon. I was on hold for an hour and told I was next in the queue the entire time. When I hit an hour of waiting they disconnected my call. Really disappointing for a supposedly emergency vet.

Great service. Lots of availability. Great vets!
Highly reccommend.

I have been a loyal client of Medivet Hendon for many years, and both of my cats, Halo and Moon, have been registered with this practice since they were kittens. Unfortunately, my recent experience has completely destroyed my confidence in this branch.

After rescuing an injured stray cat, Rufus, I phoned the practice and was told to bring him in. However, when I arrived, nobody knew about the telephone conversation. After only a very brief assessment, I was told his injury was not life-threatening and that they would not treat him.

I immediately took Rufus to another veterinary practice, where he was accepted without hesitation. They diagnosed a burst abscess that required treatment and were surprised that he had been turned away.

This experience confirmed concerns I had developed over the years that appointments at Medivet Hendon often felt rushed and impersonal. The lack of communication, compassion and care shown on this occasion was deeply disappointing.

As a result, I have made the difficult decision to move both of my own cats to another veterinary practice. I cannot recommend Medivet Hendon based on my experience.
